# The Bottoms Round

*The caravans ford the Reedwater Bottoms on the way to Kaldemor. Torvi pays for fifty reed-lurkers cleared from the ford, as often as you like.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 50 [Reed-Lurker](../monsters/reed_lurker.md) in [The Reedwater Bottoms](../maps/reedwater_bottoms.md)

## Rewards

- 33,390 EXP

- +15 standing with Urbanograd

The first time you complete it instead: +40 standing with [Torvi Brask](../npcs/torvi_brask.md), +20 standing with Urbanograd
